weeklyLogs.tasks:
-Company introduction and tour around the office 
 -Familiarized the OSP ticketing system 
 -Assisted in checking asset inventory in workspace A, B, and C 
 -Joined company group chats to stay updated 
 -Updated the status of each company asset via Excel 
 -Assisted in rebooting CCTV hardware 
 -Accomplished the moving of PC Hardware from a workstation to another 
 -Changed the battery of hygrometer which is used to monitor the temperature inside the server room to prevent complications
weeklyLogs.takeaways:
During this period, I gained a well-rounded introduction to the company's operations, starting with an office tour that helped me understand the overall workflow and layout of the different workspaces. I became familiar with the OSP ticketing system, which gave me a better grasp of how issues are logged, tracked, and resolved within the organization. I also assisted in checking asset inventory across workspaces A, B, and C, which strengthened my attention to detail and helped me understand proper asset management practices.
Staying active in company group chats allowed me to keep up with updates and improve my communication within the team. I further developed my documentation skills by updating the status of company assets through Excel, ensuring records stayed accurate and organized. On the technical side, I assisted in rebooting CCTV hardware and helped move PC hardware between workstations, both of which gave me practical exposure to basic IT support tasks. Lastly, I learned the importance of preventive maintenance by changing the battery of the hygrometer used to monitor server room temperature, helping me appreciate how small maintenance tasks play a big role in preventing larger technical complications.

weeklyLogs.tasks:
-Changed the hostname and joined each newly deployed system unit into one domain
-Physical verification of assets in our IT storage
-Returned all system unit set up to their designated desk in the Training Room
-Reimaged 5 system units to make sure they all use the same image of an operation system using MDT (Microsoft Deployment Toolkit)
-Checked if all system units in the IT storage are in one domain to get them ready for transfer to another site
weeklyLogs.takeaways: I gained practical hands-on experience in endpoint management, automated OS deployment, and IT asset logistics. By reimaging devices with the Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT), configuring hostnames, and joining systems to Active Directory, I deepened my technical skill in building standardized, secure operating environments at scale. Furthermore, executing physical inventory audits and verifying domain connectivity for site transfers enhanced my understanding of asset lifecycle management, hardware staging, and overall operational readiness within an enterprise IT infrastructure.

weeklyLogs.tasks:
-Deployment of secondary monitors to workstations
-Did a checklist for the server room, speed test of ethernet and Wifi and documented it in a spreadsheet
-Updated the assets status and location in the company OSP
-Replaced system units in the training room and changed their hostname and joined them into the domain
weeklyLogs.takeaways: From this week's tasks, I learned how to properly document network checks like speed tests and server room conditions, which helps keep records clear for future reference. I also learned how important it is to keep asset records updated, since wrong info can cause confusion later. Setting up the training room computers taught me how to rename systems and join them to a domain, which helped me understand how devices connect and get managed within a company network.
